title: Network CSV rerun start dry-run contract
summary: Added the no-write Network CSV rerun start dry-run command contract and backend precondition evidence.
reason: Phase 2 needs an operator-reviewable start plan before any coordinator batch state or worker execution exists.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun had a read-only preview model, but no start dry-run route to validate coordinator role, lifecycle readiness, duplicate-batch conflicts, worker availability, planned state files, or rollback expectations.
behavior_after: POST /api/rerun/network/start-dry-run returns a CommandResult with desktop_rerun_network_start_dry_run.v1 data, effect=none evidence, planned authorized state files, precondition status, rollback expectations, and no media, queue, network-state, or worker-start side effects.
rollback_plan: Remove the /api/rerun/network/start-dry-run registrations, payload and route contract entries, rerun_facade dry-run helpers, related tests, inventory rows, and refreshed generated summaries. No runtime state, media files, queue entries, network state, or worker processes are created by this phase.
